newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures sharply lower after data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures sharply lower after data.

text.p: June 30 - U.S. stock index futures were sharply lower but off the lowest levels of the session after stronger than expected U.S. economic data. The Chicago Purchasing Managers' index and May home sales were both above forecasts, sparking selling the in bond market that spilled over into index futures. September S&P 500s broke below several support levels. ((Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
